task.description: Root-cause diagnosis: adp09 TC-ADP-09-01 pg_proc overcounting (stale UUID-typed function overloads from an incomplete DROP FUNCTION arg list in migration 1107) and adp10 TC-ADP-10-02 payload_full (migration 1107 silently dropped the ADP-10 payload_full auto-population block, plus a second, independent stale-UUID-signature bug in bpm_audit_build_agent_payload_full). Also root-caused TC-ADP-09-02/03/04 and 5 of xc02's tests via the pre-existing, precedented session_replication_role-never-restored pattern (ISS-0149/GH-465). Fresh-database re-measurement of the remaining 26 files completed twice, each classified explicitly.

result.summary: Diagnosed and fixed adp09 fully (schema-qualified pg_proc query + new migration 1141 dropping stale UUID function overloads + session_replication_role scoping on 3 tests + ::uuid cast fix on 1 test). Diagnosed adp10's root cause fully (2 independent defects, both fixed via new migration 1142) but found the fix does not survive full-suite concurrency -- forwarded as GH-651/ISS-0646. Applied the same session_replication_role/::uuid fixes to 5 of xc02's 7 tests. Individually triaged all 26 remaining files against a freshly migrated, workspace-owned database twice: 2 already-passing, 1 flaky/noise, 19 forwarded as GH-652/ISS-0647, 1 (gh512) forwarded as GH-653/ISS-0648 (pre-existing, unrelated). 2 incidental new discoveries forwarded as GH-654/ISS-0649.
